title: Configurations of Mass Atrocity Onset: A Set-Theoretic Replication and Extension of Genocide/Politicide Risk Models
domain: genocide studies / comparative politics / conflict processes / set-theoretic methods / atrocity prevention
summary: A prevention-oriented comparative study of the configurations under which genocide, politicide, and intrastate mass killing begin. The project first reproduces classic Harff/Williams risk configurations on their original case universe, then extends them with newer public data and explicitly tests necessity, sufficiency, equifinality, causal asymmetry, and stability across outcome definitions. A periodic-table-like risk atlas is a visualization layer, not a claim that single factors deterministically cause atrocities.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C user-requested project registered 2026-09-24; initial literature anchor, outcome hierarchy, QCA design, condition ontology and source inventory frozen before outcome inspection

figures.strategy: periodic-table-like condition atlas + truth-table/pathway visualization after calibration and QCA are frozen

outputs.exception: Pre-outcome design stage. No condition is labeled necessary or sufficient until replicated and sensitivity-tested.
